newsitem.title: USA: BT said to offer cash and stock for MCI.
newsitem.headline: BT said to offer cash and stock for MCI.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is aiming to offer a mixture of cash and stock for MCI Communications Corp to bring its 20 percent stake up to 100 percent, a source close to the deal told Reuters on Friday.
MCI earlier confirmed that it was talking to BT about a business combination, but declined to give details.

The source, who spoke on condition of not being identified, said the price was still not finalized but an announcment was expected on Sunday if not before. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
